text: The HR team shall use the recruitment scoring system only according to the provider instructions and assign trained recruiters to monitor outputs and escalate abnormal operation.
The deployer shall check that operational input data is relevant and representative before it is submitted to the high-risk AI system.
The deployer shall retain system logs for compliance review and make them available for audit when required.
Before deployment, the organisation shall inform worker representatives and affected employees that AI will be used to support workplace hiring and assessment decisions.
The deployer shall complete a fundamental rights impact assessment covering affected groups, discrimination risks, human oversight, mitigation measures, and complaint handling before first use.
